problem_type: Bundled prompt availability blocked by external source latency
symptom: Cold Skill popover shows only Skills while built-in expressions wait for remote downloads
direct_cause: getPromptLibrary awaits all external downloads before prepending bundled prompts
class_root: Local availability shares the completion dependency of optional remote freshness
affected_population: Every cold or stale-cache prompt library consumer
internal_only_reason: Uses the existing bundled snapshot, disk cache, TTL and bounded refresh; no new dependency or external format.
invariants: Bundled and cached prompts are immediately available independent of network completion
generality_proof: All IPC readers converge on getPromptLibrary; local snapshot is returned while the existing single inflight refresh updates the same cache.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Return local snapshot without awaiting remote refresh

recurrence.reason: Every cold profile and every expired remote cache can trigger this.
same_class_scan: getPromptLibrary has one IPC caller, shared by composer and both libraries
Existing floor contains bundled external snapshot; builtinPacks adds 25 expressions and curated effects

prevention.invariant: Local prompt availability never waits for remote freshness
prevention.failure_mode: Existing refresh failures retain local snapshot
prevention.strategy: Return the existing hydrated floor and refresh the existing cache in the background

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove the blocking await at the sole public read boundary; keep one cache and one refresher

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing internal cache and hardened fetch retained.

residual_risks: Fresh external additions appear on a subsequent reload or application session; local built-ins remain immediately available.
